title: Getting started with bushfireheat
text: summarise_seasons() counts days season reached threshold, compare_periods() averages two periods. Canberra, fire season averaged 1.1 days 35 °C 1950–79 3.3 1996–2025, 3 times many. Average fire-season rainfall barely changed, 327 mm 317 mm.
code: seasons <- summarise_seasons(fire_daily, threshold = 35) comparison <- compare_periods(seasons) comparison #> # A tibble: 5 × 8 #>   town       baseline_hot_days recent_hot_days ratio reliable baseline_total #>   <chr>                  <dbl>           <dbl> <dbl> <lgl>             <int> #> 1 Armidale              0.0667           0.167  2.5  FALSE                 2 #> 2 Bairnsdale            4.2              5.9    1.40 TRUE                126 #> 3 Bega                  1.5              2.07   1.38 TRUE                 45 #> 4 Canberra              1.1              3.27   2.97 TRUE                 33 #> 5 Grafton               3.77             5.4    1.43 TRUE                113 #> # ℹ 2 more variables: baseline_rain <dbl>, recent_rain <dbl> plot_hot_days(seasons)

title: Compare hot days and rainfall between two periods — compare_periods
text: seasons Output summarise_seasons(). baseline, recent first last season period, inclusive, two numbers. min_hot_days fewest hot days baseline must contain, summed seasons, ratio count reliable. handful extra hot days can produce large ratio.

title: Compare hot days and rainfall between two periods — compare_periods
text: tibble one row per town columns: town Town name. baseline_hot_days, recent_hot_days Mean hot days per season period. ratio recent_hot_days / baseline_hot_days, NA baseline hot days. reliable Whether baseline least min_hot_days hot days. baseline_total Total hot days baseline. baseline_rain, recent_rain Mean total rainfall per season period, mm.

title: Compare hot days and rainfall between two periods — compare_periods
code: seasons <- summarise_seasons(fire_daily, threshold = 35) compare_periods(seasons) #> # A tibble: 5 × 8 #>   town       baseline_hot_days recent_hot_days ratio reliable baseline_total #>   <chr>                  <dbl>           <dbl> <dbl> <lgl>             <int> #> 1 Armidale              0.0667           0.167  2.5  FALSE                 2 #> 2 Bairnsdale            4.2              5.9    1.40 TRUE                126 #> 3 Bega                  1.5              2.07   1.38 TRUE                 45 #> 4 Canberra              1.1              3.27   2.97 TRUE                 33 #> 5 Grafton               3.77             5.4    1.43 TRUE                113 #> # ℹ 2 more variables: baseline_rain <dbl>, recent_rain <dbl>  # A higher threshold leaves too few baseline hot days in some towns compare_periods(summarise_seasons(fire_daily, threshold = 40)) #> # A tibble: 5 × 8 #>   town       baseline_hot_days recent_hot_days ratio reliable baseline_total #>   <chr>                  <dbl>           <dbl> <dbl> <lgl>             <int> #> 1 Armidale               0               0     NA    FALSE                 0 #> 2 Bairnsdale             0.233           0.7    3    FALSE                 7 #> 3 Bega                   0               0.133 NA    FALSE                 0 #> 4 Canberra               0               0     NA    FALSE                 0 #> 5 Grafton                0.1             0.167  1.67 FALSE                 3 #> # ℹ 2 more variables: baseline_rain <dbl>, recent_rain <dbl>
